name: UI tweaks
description: A wider chat, bigger or smaller text, compact rows, the agent's steps open, and the parts of the app you never use hidden.
author: Codex Mods
about: Each tweak uses the app's own sizes, so it follows the app's look in light and dark. Turn the mod off and the app is as it was.
Hidden parts lists what each place of the app draws; check what you never use.

items.title: Chat width
items.description: How wide a chat's conversation runs.

items.title: Chat text
items.description: The size of what you and the agent write.

items.title: Code text
items.description: The size of code in a chat.

items.title: Row height
items.description: The height of rows in lists, the sidebar's chats among them.

items.title: Show steps expanded
items.description: Each command, edit and tool call opens with its detail, until you close it.

items.title: Unfold each turn
items.description: A finished turn shows its steps, not just its answer.

settings.title: Hidden parts
settings.description: Chosen on the Hidden parts tab.
